answer: One defense is a relic stake: every identity must hold a relic, a unique artifact minted only by finishing a public, verifiable task that takes real time and cannot be bought or transferred. A river of random peer challenges then flows past each epoch, forcing every holder to re-prove the work behind its relic. To forge one fake, an attacker must mint a fresh relic from scratch; to run a hundred fakes, it must redo that work a hundred times, while an honest agent tends a single relic.
